nodes.procedure: The process consisted of first cutting the nickel foam paper sheet into 3×6 cm pieces, followed by cleaning for 20 min using ultrasonic cleaner and hydrochloric acid, anhydrous ethanol, and deionized water. The resulting platforms were then dried in a vacuum oven at 60 °C.

nodes.name: NiFe LDH/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: The process consisted of mixing 80 mL deionized water, 33.85 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.55 mmol Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, 20 mmol urea, and 8 mmol NH4F under magnetic stirring for 30 min to form NiFe LDH precursor solution. Next, the resulting mixture was added to the previously pretreated nickel foam in a 100 mL reactor followed by heating to 120 °C for 8 h. The unreacted residues were removed by regularly cleaning the foam with distilled water and ethanol once it cooled down to room temperature to yield a product labeled NiFe LDH/NF after drying in a vacuum oven.

nodes.name: W-Ni2P/NF hydrothermal + phosphidation
nodes.procedure: The preparation process consisted of adding 2 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 8 mmol urea, 4 mmol NH4F, and 2 mmol (NH4)6W7O24·6H2O to 80 mL of deionized water. The resulting clear solution was mixed with the previously pretreated nickel foam in a 100 mL reactor heated at 120 °C for 7 h. Next, the nickel foam was removed and repeatedly cleaned with distilled water along with ethanol after it cooled to room temperature followed by drying in a vacuum oven. The mixture was finally transferred to a tube furnace, with 1 g NaH2PO2 placed in a porcelain boat as a phosphorus source. The annealing process was carried out under the argon atmosphere at 350 °C for 2 h to yield a sample labeled as W-Ni2P/NF once it cooled down.

nodes.name: NiFe LDH@W-Ni2P/NF hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: The process consisted of mixing 80 mL deionized water, 33.85 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.55 mmol Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, 20 mmol urea, and 8 mmol NH4F under magnetic stirring for 30 min. The resulting W-Ni2P/NF was mixed with the above solution and placed in a high-pressure reactor at 120 °C for 8 h. The product was then repeatedly cleaned with distilled water along with ethanol followed by drying in a vacuum oven set at 60 °C for 3 h to yield a product labeled NiFe LDH@W–Ni2P/NF.

nodes.name: W-Ni2P@NiFe LDH/NF hydrothermal + phosphidation
nodes.procedure: The procedure consisted of preparing an aqueous solution by mixing 2 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 8 mmol urea, 4 mmol NH4F, and 2 mmol (NH4)6W7O24·6H2O in 80 mL purified water under constant stirring for 30 min. The resulting NiFe-LDH/NF was mixed with the above solution and placed in a high-pressure reactor at 120 °C for 4, 7, and 10 h. The product was then repeatedly cleaned with distilled water along with ethanol followed by drying in a vacuum oven set at 60 °C for 3 h. The product was then transferred to a tube furnace with simultaneously placed 1 g NaH2PO2 in a porcelain boat as a phosphorus source. The calcination process was performed for 2 h at 350 °C under Ar protective gas followed by cooling to ambient temperature to yield W-Ni2P@NiFe LDH/NF-4, W-Ni2P@NiFe LDH/NF-7, and W-Ni2P@NiFe LDH/NF-10.
